stem:
The objects on the scale make it balance exactly. On the left pan there is a 1 kg weight (mass) and half a brick. On the right pan there is one brick.

[Image: A balance scale with objects on each pan]

What is the weight (mass) of one brick?
figure_description: A two-pan balance scale is shown balanced horizontally on a central pivot and base. On the left pan, there is a weight labeled "1 kg" shaped like a standard counterweight, and a standing rectangular block representing half a brick. On the right pan, there is a larger rectangular block representing one whole brick, which has the same height as the block on the left pan but twice its width.
